name: Isabelle Dubois
bio:
Isabelle's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, sparked by a childhood fascination with intricate watch mechanisms in her grandfather's workshop. This passion for precision led her to study mechanical engineering, where she excelled in material science and failure analysis. After graduating, she initially worked in the aerospace industry, contributing to the quality control of aircraft components.

Driven by a desire to combine her engineering expertise with her love for racing, Isabelle transitioned to motorsport, joining Ipiranga Racing five years ago. Her meticulous approach to quality control ensures that every component meets stringent standards, minimizing the risk of mechanical failures on the track. Isabelle's colleagues appreciate her dedication and keen eye for detail, often seeking her input on complex technical challenges.

What sets Isabelle apart is her proactive attitude towards innovation. She is always looking for ways to improve testing methodologies and implement new technologies to enhance the team's quality assurance processes. Her insights have been instrumental in preventing several potential setbacks, solidifying her reputation as an invaluable asset to Ipiranga Racing.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Isabelle has a focused gaze and a slender build, always appearing alert and ready for inspection.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of Swiss-made calipers for all measurements.
Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when concentrating.
